CustomField.description: The article code as a unique, case-insensitive external id - the upsert key for the Mexal and WooCommerce integrations. Replaces Code__c, deleted 2026-09-02, and restores the atomic uniqueness that ProductCode cannot provide. Deliberately NOT universally required, unlike Code__c: a required field cannot carry field-level security and cannot appear in a permission set. ProductCode is kept as the human-facing code and the two are expected to match.
CustomField.label: External Product Code
